summary: I developed a web tool for children to learn about abandoned spacecraft on/near Mars: Dawn, Sojourner, and Ingenuity. The story of each mission is told in child-friendly language with tools such as definitions and visual aids.
details:
This project is intended for young children to learn about the spacecraft around Mars. It provides a simple UI and simple language to make the content accessible and interactive. Hovering over complicated words provides definitions in simpler language.

The website is housed in GitHub, and uses images and facts mainly from the NASA Science website.

In making this project, I learned a lot about best practices for HTML and CSS. I also learned how to fetch from an API: I wanted to have the background pull space images from NASA's Picture of the Day to make every visit to the website exciting, but I could not find a functional API that only had space photos.

With more time, I would add an audio track for each story, as well as add in the stories of the rest of the spacecrafts on Mars.
